rows.en:
MBR-04-Mk IV Tomahawk
Large beam cannons on both arms, plus missiles, MGs and more. Fit for many roles: storming enemy ships, city defense, interception.
rows.notes: Title Mk IV per glossary (Roman IV not in charset).

rows.en:
Heavy artillery Destroid
Front-mounted weapons make it excel at concentrated fire
Super Flamethrower
rows.notes: SP attack name of the Tomahawk (literally super flame-throwing).

rows.en:
ADR-04-Mk X Defender
Twin AA guns on both arms. With a large radar for ultra-long-range space combat, it stood in for gun turrets defending the Macross.

Anti-air interceptor Destroid
Used as one of the Macross's anti-air weapons
Super Shot

SDR-04-Mk XII Phalanx
Carries masses of missiles on both arms. Served as the Macross's AA fire when the Zentradi surprise attack left too few gun turrets ready.

Close-in air defense Destroid for space
Excels at short-range attacks
Full Salvo

MBR-07-Mk II Spartan
Built for close combat with giant aliens. After the war it was also sent to quell riots by aliens who could not adapt to life on Earth.

Close-combat Destroid
Heavily armored and highly mobile
Melee Combo

HWR-00-Mk II Monster
Four large cannons on its head and missile launchers on its arms. The U.N. Forces' top firepower, but its heavy arms leave it slow.

Ultra-long-range artillery Destroid
Terrible mobility, but tremendous firepower

SDF-1 Macross
An alien battleship that suddenly fell to Earth. Its arrival brought humanity face to face with OverTechnology far beyond its own.

Super Dimension Fortress rebuilt from a giant space battleship
Armed with weapons of many kinds of OverTechnology

VF-1D Valkyrie
Two-seat VF-1A, mainly for training. Hikaru Ichijyo, caught up in the Zentradi surprise attack, flew it to save Minmay.

Valkyrie used as a training craft
A trainer, but also capable of real combat

VF-1A Valkyrie (Standard)
The most widely deployed variable fighter on the Macross. Mainly flown by regular pilots. Fights anywhere, from ground to space.

Standard mass-produced Valkyrie of the VF-1 series
Mainly used by regular soldiers

VF-1A Valkyrie (Max)
Max's blue unit. Same specs as the standard model, but its genius pilot drew the attention of friend and foe alike.

Standard mass-produced Valkyrie of the VF-1 series
Max's unit, with blue as his personal color
Clone
rows.notes: Max SP attack 'bunshin' (split self / clone images). Chose Clone.

rows.en:
VF-1A Valkyrie (Hikaru)
Hikaru's unit in the film. To counter the overwhelming Zentradi forces, its missile load, range and thrust are greatly increased.
rows.notes: Title has no film marker in the source, so none added; body says it is the film version.

rows.en:
Known as the Super Valkyrie
Hikaru's unit with more acceleration, mobility and firepower

VF-1J Valkyrie (Hikaru)
Hikaru's unit after he became a U.N. Forces pilot. Outperforms the A model, with more firepower from twin head lasers.

Valkyrie with upgraded weapons over the VF-1A
Hikaru's unit, the hero mecha of Macross

VF-1J Valkyrie (Max)
Given to Max after he married Milia. Again painted blue. Flying with Milia's red unit, he racked up even more victories.

Valkyrie with upgraded weapons over the VF-1A
Max's unit, with blue as his personal color
Speed Up

VF-1J Valkyrie (Milia)
Given to Milia after she married Max. Again painted red. Flying with Max's blue unit, she racked up even more victories.

Valkyrie with upgraded weapons over the VF-1A
Milia's unit, with red as her personal color

VF-1J Valkyrie (Hikaru)
A VF-1J wearing armor that adds both weapons and plating. Heavily armored and loaded with arms, it can down a battleship alone.
rows.notes: Armored version; source title carries no (A) marker, kept as written.

rows.en:
Known as the Armored Valkyrie
Hikaru's unit, boasting heavy armor and high firepower

VF-1S Valkyrie (Roy)
High-end unit for squadron leaders. After Focker was killed in action, his junior Hikaru Ichijyo flew it to defend the Macross.
rows.notes: Unit suffix (Roy) as in the unit table (u0159); body keeps Focker as written.

rows.en:
High-performance commander's Valkyrie
Focker's unit, with a skull as its trademark

VF-1S Valkyrie (Hikaru)
Upgraded Super Parts with twin beam cannons. In the final battle it stormed the enemy flagship with the Macross and beat Boddole Zer.
rows.notes: Source says Super Parts (not Super Pack); kept. Enemy mothership rendered as flagship.

rows.en:
Known as the Strike Valkyrie
Hikaru's unit with powerful twin beam cannons

VF-1S Valkyrie (Roy)
Sortied to save Hikaru and co. from the Zentradi. Met Quamzin in an enemy ship and saved them, but the two took each other down.
rows.notes: Source 'aiuchi' = both took each other down.

rows.en:
Known as the Strike Valkyrie
Focker's unit with powerful twin beam cannons

Regult
The Zentradi's most widely used battle pod. Swappable weapons suit it to many operations. Not popular with the troops.

The Zentradi forces' main battle pod
Simple in design and easy to field

Glaug
High-end unit with large cannons on both arms plus many lasers and machine guns. As Quamzin's ride, it tormented the Macross.

Battle pod developed from collected combat data
High-performance, and especially good at melee

Nousjadeul-Ger
Humanoid powered suit, more mobile and comfier than the Regult. Well armed, with shoulder cannons, handheld weapons, etc.

The Zentradi forces' main powered suit
Excels in firepower, agility and mobility

Queadluun-Rau (Standard)
High-end Meltrandi battle suit. Highly mobile, it threatened Valkyrie squadrons with powerful weapons and many missiles.

Battle suit developed by the Zentradi forces
Mainly used by regular soldiers

Queadluun-Rau (Milia)
Milia's red unit. Unbeaten, she was feared even by allies. After a fierce dogfight, Max finally got on her tail and shot her down.
rows.notes: Source passive (had her back taken and was shot down) made active with Max as agent; Max is named in the sentence.

rows.en:
Battle suit developed by the Zentradi forces
Milia's unit, with red as her personal color

Queadluun-Rau (Max)
Blue unit of Max, who married Milia and grew to Zentradi size. Teamed with Milia's unit, he racked up huge victories.

Battle suit developed by the Zentradi forces
Max's unit, with blue as his personal color

Zentradi Soldier
A rank-and-file Zentradi soldier. Wears only a spacesuit, but at over 10 m tall is no weaker than a Battroid in melee.

A soldier of the Zentradi forces
A giant five times the height of a human

Vrlitwhai Kridanik
Zentradi fleet commander. Tougher than regular soldiers, he can work in space unprotected for a short time. A strong fighter too.

Zentradi fleet commander
A warrior who can down a Valkyrie bare-handed

Golg Boddole Zer
Zentradi fleet supreme commander. Central bio-unit of a mobile fortress built 120,000 cycles ago; larger than normal Zentradi.

Zentradi fleet supreme commander
The living central unit of the Boddole flagship
rows.notes: 'Boddole kan' (Boddole ship) not in glossary; rendered the Boddole flagship.

rows.en: Tentacle Frenzy

VF-11B Thunderbolt
Produced as the forerunner of the VF-11C. Isamu flew it while hunting down Zentradi remnants scattered across space.

Variable fighter developed as the VF-1's successor
A VF-14A with improved engine thrust
rows.notes: Source says the unit is a VF-14A with boosted engine thrust; translated as written although odd for a VF-11B.

rows.en:
YF-19 Excalibur (Isamu)
New engines give it high mobility, but make it hard to handle. Heads to Earth to rescue Myung, held captive by Sharon.

Prototype variable fighter of the VF-19
Isamu's unit, powerful but temperamental

YF-21 Sturmvogel (Guld)
Flown by brain waves. Guld charged the Ghost, a new unmanned fighter run by Sharon, to stop it; both were destroyed.
rows.notes: Title: glossary has only YF-21; Sturmvogel taken from VF-22S Sturmvogel II. 'Tokkou' = suicide charge; 'aiuchi' = both destroyed.

rows.en:
Prototype variable fighter of the VF-22
Guld's unit, fitted with the BDI system
Charge

VF-11C Thunderbolt (Standard)
U.N. Forces mainstay from A.D. 2040 on. Its easy handling and maintenance kept it the main fighter for a long time.
rows.notes: Source starts with seireki, so A.D. kept; source says U.N. Forces (not New U.N.).

rows.en:
Variable fighter developed as the VF-1's successor
Mainly used by regular soldiers

VF-17D Nightmare (Standard)
Stealth unit for special missions. A big frame with many weapons. After the Protodeviln appeared, it mainly defended City 7.

Variable fighter developed for special missions
Mainly used by the Diamond Force team

VF-17S Nightmare (Kinryu/Gamlin)
Commander version of the VF-17. After leader Kinryu died, Gamlin took over Diamond Force and flew this unit.

Variable fighter developed for special missions
Mainly used by the Diamond Force leader

VF-17S Nightmare (Milia)
To protect City 7, cut off from the fleet by an enemy ploy, Mayor Milia flew leader Kinryu's old unit, repainted red.

Variable fighter developed for special missions
Milia's unit, with red as her personal color

VF-22S Sturmvogel II (Max)
Max flew it to attack the Protodeviln nest. A high-end unit full of new tech, such as the ability to fold alone.
rows.notes: Single-unit fold navigation compressed to fold alone.

rows.en:
Special-mission VF, successor to the VF-17
Max's unit, with blue as his personal color

VF-22S Sturmvogel II (Milia)
Milia's red unit. She fought beside Max in Operation Stargazer, and once even sang with a Sound Booster fitted.

Special-mission VF, successor to the VF-17
Milia's unit, with red as her personal color
Mylene Valkyrie

VF-11MAXL Kai Mylene Valkyrie (Mylene)
VF-11 modified for Mylene, known for its feminine Battroid mode. She sang with Basara, making the battlefield her stage.

uncertain: u0783 Max SP attack 'bunshin' rendered Clone (alternatives: Afterimage, Shadow Clone).
u0790 SP attack 'kousokuka' rendered Speed Up.
u0797 Source says Super Parts (not the glossary Super Pack); kept as Super Parts.
u0809 Passive 'caught from behind and shot down' rewritten with Max as agent.
u0818 'Boddole kan' not in glossary; rendered the Boddole flagship.
u0821 Source calls the VF-11B a VF-14A with boosted thrust; translated literally.
u0824 YF-21 Sturmvogel: glossary lists only YF-21; nickname taken by analogy to VF-22S Sturmvogel II.
